jobs.description:
An international Belgian software developer builds its own innovative SaaS solutions for the manufacturing industry. Their software helps manufacturing companies worldwide work smarter, more efficiently, and in a more automated way. Within their Cloud Development team, they are working on a modern, cloud-native solution that is being further built from the ground up using technologies such as .NET and Azure.
In addition, they actively work with AI tools such as Claude Code within an agentic engineering context.
Due to expansion and their continued success, they are currently looking for strong profiles.

Jobomschrijving

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.
In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.
You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar
• Strong professional experience in .NET development
• Interest in AI tools
• You work in English, Dutch is a plus

Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator / Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

At the request of business stakeholders, the candidate analyzes, configures, and codes application software components in accordance with specified changes, standards, and procedures.
Key responsibilities

• Analyze business requirements to define software specifications and perform detailed technical studies

• Configure ERP application packages and develop prototypes

• Develop and test software modules, including unit and integration testing, and resolve defects

• Assemble software components and produce corresponding documentation

• Execute corrective and evolutionary maintenance and manage reusable software components

• Technical analysis

• ERP configuration

• Prototyping

• Unit and integration testing

• Software documentation

• Software maintenance

Qualifications

• Between 3 and 5 years of experience in .NET development

• Between 3 and 5 years of experience with APIs

• Between 3 and 5 years of professional use of English

Do you want to be a part of one of the fastest-growing and largest Security Operations Centers in Europe? Do you have a passion for Cyber Security, especially advanced Managed Detection & Response (MDR)? Does Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence and everything related to Cyber Security feel like second nature to you? Are you a Cyber Defender at heart, driven to strengthen the blue team and help organizations that are under attack? If you answered yes to all of these questions, you might be the perfect fit for our CSIRT Analyst role.
 

• You handle security alerts/incidents that have been escalated by the SOC Analysts (Tier 2)
• You conduct DFIR assignments, including DFIR readiness assessments
• You participate in the weekly Threat Hunting duty to proactively chase threats through novel Tools, Techniques & Procedures (TTPs)
• You will perform compromise assessments to identify potential compromises and their scope
• You collect Threat Intelligence (IOCs and TTPs)
• You will contribute to Detection Engineering in SIEM, xDR, …
• Together with the Red Team you will do Purple Teaming exercises to test and improve defenses
• You contribute to the creation of playbooks in SOAR
• You will co-write processes and procedures related to DFIR, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, …
• You will be part of our Incident Response on call service.

Profile

• You have at least 3-5 years of experience in a similar position
• You have a bachelor or master degree or equivalent through experience
• You are able to perform forensically sound acquisition, parsing and analysis of disk, memory images, forensic artifacts and logs in order to rebuild the timeline of events for a cybersecurity incident. Extensive hands-on experience in this domain of expertise is mandatory
• You have experience and/or interest in working with the following MDR tools: EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon, MS Defender for Endpoint, Sentinel One, ...), NDR (Vectra, Darktrace, ...), xDR (CrowdStrike Identity Protection, MS Defender for Office/Clouds Apps/Identity/...)
• As an analyst or engineer, you already have a good knowledge of Security Monitoring with SIEM technologies
• You are passionate about the following security capabilities: Security Monitoring, Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, ...
• You have a hands-on and proactive mindset with a 'can do' mentality
• You speak and write English fluently.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

As part of the IT team, you will be the first point of contact for end users and help ensure a smooth and efficient IT experience across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first-line IT support to employees.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, and Microsoft 365 issues.
• Managing incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
• Preparing and configuring laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Assisting with onboarding and offboarding activities.
• Escalating complex issues when necessary and following up to resolution.
• Delivering excellent customer service to users at all levels of the business.

Profile

• A degree in IT or a first experience/internship in IT support.
• Basic knowledge of Windows environments and Microsoft 365.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent French and a good level of English. Dutch is a plus.
• A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong customer-service mindset.
• Team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• Great level of English (fluent speaker)

Production worker – early hours
Manpower is excited to help you find the perfect match for your dream job!
 We're looking for an early bird to join our production team in Zele for a fast-growing family business!
 

Jobomschrijving

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.

We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.
You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.
Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!
 Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

What will you do?  

• Assist our customers with architecture and design of high available, secure and scalable integration solutions. 
• You’ll delve into the creation of an integration reference architecture, integration frameworks and integration strategy. 
• By promoting modularity, scalability and maintainability, you’ll design and develop integration architectures.  
• Cooperate with the customers' project teams to realize sustainable integration solutions.  
• After the implementation phase, you’ll mentor and coach (potential) customers in the Integration methodology and frameworks  
 

Who are we looking for?  

• Experience with one or more middleware technologies and interface technologies and concepts.  
• Already worked with architecture/design modeling languages and have hands-on experience with the design or architectures of integrations, services, API’s, etc.  
• Understand how orchestration and choreography realize business processes and have experience with synchronous and asynchronous integration.  
• Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English  
• Thrives in a hybrid environment, but is also willing to commute to Antwerp, Brussels, or Ghent on a regular basis. 
• Education level minimum Bachelor or equivalent through experience.

The Group Controller will be responsible for the finances of the holding and the consolidation for the analytic Reporting at Group Level. The role includes a quite operational maintenance of the business controlling, with an eye for details and a strong analytical mind, as well as the opportunity to discuss strategic matters and have a direct impact on the results of the company, driving the financial performance of the Group.

Jobomschrijving

The Group Controller plays a role at the center of the group activities and will manage a wide range of responsibilities. This role is transverse with a global vision and the will to have an impact. 

Group consolidation and financial reporting

• Coordinate group-wide budgets, forecasts, and long-term planning across all entities
• Contribute to financial reporting for executive management, Board, and Audit Committee
• Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making

Monitoring of holding costs

• Coordinate and monitor holding-level costs during budget and forecast cycles
• Consolidate and analyze intercompany cost data
• Ensure correct and consistent application of transfer pricing policies

Continuous improvement of financial processes and tools

• Drive improvements in financial processes, reporting, and tools
• Collaborate with controlling teams to implement best practices
• Support standardization and automation initiatives across finance

The Group Controller presents a certain set of hard and soft skills:

• Master's degree in finance, Business Management, Economics - or equivalent
• Around 4-5 years of experience in Finance (ideally in a controlling position)
• Excellent command of French & English - Dutch is a plus
• Experience with SAP
• An affinity with process management and IT tools
• Solution oriented and Proactive
• Critical mindset
• Excellent communication skills and partnering approach

The Group Controller - Consolidation will have the unique opportunity to enter a well-established, leader in its market company within a dynamic and new Financial Team. It is the opportunity to be part of a real project and to bring direct added value to the function and the Group.

jobs.occupation: Consolidation Officer in a Listed Belgian Company - Brussels
jobs.description:
In the context of transformation in the energy sector and international growth, the company is strengthening its central finance team to support its consolidation and reporting activities at group level. The Consolidation Officer has a global view and global responsibilities over the whole business.

Jobomschrijving

As Consolidation Officer, you directly report to the Manager and work in a team of 3. The consolidation team is stable and has great evolution perspective.

Therefore, keep in mind that the function is open to evolution and growth.

• Perform group consolidation for monthly, quarterly and annual closings.
• Prepare consolidation adjustments and reconcile intercompany transactions.
• Support the preparation of consolidated financial statements and reports.
• Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making.
• Ensure compliance with group accounting policies and IFRS standards.
• Coordinate with internal teams and support internal and external audits.
• Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and improvement of consolidation processes and tools.

As the function will be central and will also show great perspectives, the profile will have to show a certain set of hard and soft skills:

• Master's degree in Finance / Business Management / Economics - Or equivalent
• At least 2 or 3 years of financial experience (audit is a plus - consolidation experience is a real added value)
• IFRS knowledge / experience is a plus
• Fluent in English, good French and/or Dutch command (written and spoken)
• Proactive and Outgoing: being able to go out of your comfort zone, to take initiative
• Positive and result oriented

Mainly, the right candidate will have had to have at least a first financial experience, and will demonstrate a great ambition, the desire to learn and to evolve.

the client is a leading international professional services and consulting firm that supports organisations in their digital transformation journey. Working with both local and multinational clients, you will help businesses optimise their commercial, marketing and customer service processes through innovative CRM solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programmes, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on clients' business performance.

Jobomschrijving

As Salesforce Consultant, you will have the fllowing responsibilities:

• Partner with Belgian and international organisations to analyse business challenges across Sales, Marketing and Customer Service.
• Translate business needs into effective CRM solutions, supporting clients throughout their digital transformation journey.
• Lead or own specific workstreams while collaborating closely with functional and technical consultants to ensure successful project delivery.
• Participate in all phases of CRM implementation projects, including business analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post go-live support.
• Contribute to business development initiatives by supporting client proposals, presentations and commercial opportunities.
• Work within cross-functional teams in an agile project environment to deliver high-quality solutions.

• At least 3 years of experience working with Salesforce in either a functional or technical consulting role.
• Proven involvement in several CRM implementation projects from analysis through delivery.
• Good understanding of customer relationship management processes and commercial business operations.
• Ability to translate commercial objectives and business requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Familiarity with Sales, Marketing and/or Customer Service functions.
• Experience working in Agile environments is considered an advantage.
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
• Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international environments.
• Fluent in English together with either Dutch or French.
• Experience with Salesforce is essential; exposure to other enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP or Oracle is considered a plus.

Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Turkish is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

Line Supervisor | 2 Shifts

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Are you an experienced operator who is ready to take the next step in your career?
Do you already have some initial experience in leadership and are you able to motivate and guide a team of employees?

Job Description:

• You are responsible for the production line assigned to you.
• Your team consists of about 9 employees (both permanent and temporary staff).
• You motivate your entire team and ensure a positive atmosphere and strong cooperation.
• You also actively take part in the production process, monitoring and controlling it.
• You stay alert and suggest improvements.
• You are able to solve small technical issues.
• During shift changes, you are responsible for the handover.

• You have experience leading a team.
• You have strong social and communication skills, allowing you to communicate effectively (also with technicians and other departments).
• Working with people of different nationalities does not intimidate you.
• You can express yourself well in English. Basic knowledge of Bulgarian or Polish is a plus.
• Your formal education is less important, but you have a strong motivation to keep learning.
• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.
• You take responsibility for your work.
• You report to the Production Manager.

AANBOD

What do you get?

• A varied and responsible position where you get the opportunity to further develop your leadership skills.
• Work in a dynamic environment, where no two days are the same and you are constantly challenged to optimize processes and lead a motivated team.
• A commuting allowance, so you can travel to and from work comfortably and cost-effectively.
